dialect.detail: Generic COBOL-85 style; no vendor-specific extensions visible. Uses indexed files with DYNAMIC access and END-IF, consistent with COBOL-85 minimum. Could compile under GnuCOBOL or Micro Focus.

purpose.domain_detail: Supply chain and blockchain transaction database management; opens and manages three indexed files for supply chain records, blockchain records, and transactions.
purpose.summary: This program opens three indexed files (supply chain, blockchain, and transaction) in I-O mode and checks their file status codes for errors. It provides open/close and status-check paragraphs, relying on COPY statements to bring in the actual record layouts. It appears to be a database management utility module for a supply chain or blockchain-related application.

notable_features: Three indexed files with DYNAMIC access mode
COPY statements for record layouts (SUPPLY-CHAIN-RECORD, BLOCKCHAIN-RECORD, TRANSACTION-RECORD)
FILE STATUS checking for all three files
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
verdict.notes: The program is a skeleton/stub: it only opens, closes, and checks file status. The actual record structures are in copybooks not shown. The blockchain/supply-chain naming suggests a demo or educational exercise rather than production code. No error handling beyond DISPLAY statements.
